title: Offset of a field
statement: Given a finite list of finite lists of symbols and a natural number $j$, the offset of field $j$ is the sum, over the first $j$ fields (or all fields if there are fewer than $j$), of each field's length plus one.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list of finite lists of symbols
